title: Skip incompatible same-source checks when selecting a registered evaluation proof
outcome: Let registered evaluation selection use a compatible original proof when a newer same-source check belongs to a different path encountered during a permitted detour.
acceptance: After passing check A1 at path A, a passing same-source check B1 at path B, and returning to A with a later compatible binding, evaluate selects the valid A1 proof or returns its existing typed evaluation refusal rather than leaking B1's WorkCompletionRefused.
Behavior tests cover the detour with an intervening check, preserve newer relevant failed-check vetoes and release/source/root fences, and leave legacy/staged selection strict.
